info.name: Cento StoreSparc Video API (Local Next.js)
info.description:
Postman testing collection for the newly integrated StoreSparc Video Rendering Engine in cento-local Next.js.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default: http://localhost:3000)

formdata.description: Image URL (or uncheck and attach a file with key 'product')
Music presets: upbeat_retail, energetic_sale, modern_store, luxury_minimal, none
Optional custom MP3/WAV audio track upload

request.description: Queues a new video render job. Automatically saves job_id into collection variable {{jobId}}.

request.description: Same as 1, but using JSON payload.
Polls the status of the job. Returns completed MP4 video details when finished.

request.description: Creates a new full-fidelity Storesparc Video template with custom layers, coordinates, animations, and aspect settings.
Fetches the full specification and layers for a specific template (View Option).
Updates layers, timings, or specifications for an existing template (Edit Option).
Permanently deletes a template by ID (Delete Option).
